phases.title: Shared infrastructure setup: default configuration file, feature-split.js skeleton with FeatureSplitError and facade contract, slug rule, registry read and temp-and-rename write helpers, staging leftover scan
As a calling feature script, I want to load the merged configuration with validation so that thresholds are never hard-coded
As a calling feature script, I want a single new-feature test so that both checkpoints decide newness the same way
As a user, I want to build and edit a split proposal with warnings so that I can review it before anything is applied

commit.subject: implement US-03 build and edit proposal

phases.title: As a user, I want a confirmed split applied atomically, as an initial split or a late child, so that the epic record, child folders and registry stay consistent
As a calling feature script, I want to register a standalone feature in the registry so that it is recorded once as defined
As a Requirements or Tech-Spec generator agent, I want to read child and epic registry entries and epic.md so that standalone, child and epic features are classified correctly

US-03-TASK-BE-06.title: Add and export editProposal

US-04-TASK-BE-10.title: Add staged move journal and rollback engine
US-04-TASK-BE-10.outcome: feature-split.js has a commit routine that stages child folders, the new epic.md and the parent rollback copy under .split-staging-<run id>. In initial mode the parent's generated req/ and spec/ folders, when present, are moved into .split-staging-<run id>/parent-backup/ before epic.md is moved in. It moves everything with same-volume renames, journals each move, and writes the registry last with the temp-and-rename helper. On any failure it replays the journal in reverse, which restores req/ and spec/ in place, removes the staging directory and the temp file, and leaves the registry unchanged. If a reverse rename fails it keeps the staging directory and throws ROLLBACK_FAILED listing the remaining paths. After a successful commit it removes the staging directory and with it the backup; if that removal fails it returns a warning and does not undo the split.

commit.subject: add staged move and rollback engine
